goal: Give every feature an eval proving it across UI, backend log, DB rows and returned output, and make running them a pipeline stage.

nodes.title: Author EVALS.md: feature table and per-eval four-surface definitions
invariants: every eval accounts for all four surfaces
a surface the feature lacks is n/a with a reason, never a fabricated assertion
platform features are marked not-implemented and never reported as passing
acceptance_criteria: AC1 EVALS.md covers 7 Legacy v0 features and 14 specified platform features
AC2 every eval accounts for all four surfaces

evidence.output_excerpt: 7 Legacy rows and 14 platform rows in the feature table
every row prints UI/LOG/DB/OUT; no MISSING marks

nodes.title: Write the zero-dependency eval runner bound to existing tests and real CLI runs
invariants: a missing surface is a hard failure (MISSING)
blocked and not-implemented never count as passing and never affect the exit code
surfaces bind to existing tests rather than reimplementing assertions
acceptance_criteria: AC3 pnpm eval runs, prints the matrix, exits 0 when asserted surfaces pass
AC4 blocked and not-implemented never count as passing
AC5 the runner does not reimplement test logic

evidence.output_excerpt: 14/14 asserted surfaces passed - 0 failed - 14 features not implemented (never counted as passing); exit 0
L6 reports 3 blocked surfaces and P1-P14 report not-impl; exit stays 0 and none appear in the 14/14 asserted count
surfaces reference existing vitest files by path (profile-repo, ingest-repo, verify, render-month-table, es/report, args) plus one real CLI spawn - no assertions duplicated

nodes.title: Add the /eval command and wire stage 7b into the contract, DoD, /spec, /test and /acceptance
invariants: a new feature is not done until it has an eval row
the Definition of Done requires runnable evals green
EVALS.md is declared hand-edited, not generated
acceptance_criteria: AC6 /eval exists as stage 7b and the DoD requires runnable evals green
AC7 /spec requires an eval row for every new feature

evidence.output_excerpt: stage 7b present in the lifecycle; the Definition of Done now opens with 'Runnable feature evals green (pnpm eval ...)'
1 - /spec now requires an eval row naming how each of the four surfaces is checked or why it is n/a

nodes.title: Run the evals, record results, sync, reconcile and commit
invariants: the generated contract stays in sync
acceptance_criteria: AC3 pnpm eval runs and exits 0
verification_commands: sh scripts/sync-ai-docs.sh && git diff --exit-code -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md GEMINI.md

evidence.output_excerpt: 14/14 asserted surfaces passed - 0 failed - 14 features not implemented; exit 0

evidence.command: sh scripts/sync-ai-docs.sh && git diff --exit-code -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md GEMINI.md
